component.name: Magpie
component.summary: Every agent's model, in one place

description.p: Magpie keeps one local gateway for the AI agents installed on this machine. Pick the model each agent runs on from a single list — an API key, a local model, or a Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or Grok plan you are already signed in to — and Magpie rewrites that agent's own configuration file, keeping its comments and ordering.

ul.li: One model picker for every agent, written into the agent's own config
A local gateway at 127.0.0.1:3425 speaking OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Gemini
Providers from presets, custom base URLs, subscriptions and local servers
Routing groups that fail over between models and accounts when a quota runs out
Profiles that save and switch every agent's setup at once
Usage, cost, quota and session views
Menu bar panel, window, terminal UI, web UI and CLI in the same binary
